logger.doc:name: Log Flow Triggered
logger.message: UC1 sync triggered. Flow=[#[app.name default "d365-hubspot-sync-uc1"]], timestamp=[#[(now() as String) default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Main Logic Start
logger.message: Starting main-logic-flow. Watermark key=[${sync.watermark.key}], objectStore=[${watermark.object.store.name}]

os:retrieve.doc:name: Retrieve lastSyncTime
os:retrieve.os:default-value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- /* Static Date for Testing: Ensures we pick up the sample invoice */ p('sync.default.lastSyncTime')]

logger.doc:name: Log Retrieved Watermark Value
logger.message: Watermark retrieved safely. lastSyncTime=[#[vars.lastSyncTime default ""]]

set-variable.doc:name: Set Current Run Time to Midnight

logger.doc:name: Log Current Run Time
logger.message: Computed currentRunTime safely. currentRunTime=[#[vars.currentRunTime default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Watermark
logger.message: Fetching D365 Invoices with InvoiceDate after: #[vars.lastSyncTime]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain var entityName = "SalesInvoiceHeadersV4" var selectParams = "?\$select=InvoiceNumber,InvoiceDate,TotalInvoiceAmount,InvoiceCustomerAccountNumber"
/* CHANGED: Swapped 'ge' to 'gt' to avoid fetching the boundary record twice */ var filterParams = "&\$filter=InvoiceDate gt " ++ vars.lastSyncTime ++ " and InvoiceDate lt " ++ vars.currentRunTime --- entityName ++ selectParams ++ filterParams

logger.doc:name: Log D365 Query Built
logger.message: Built D365 query payload safely. query=[#[payload default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log D365 Retrieve Completed
logger.message: D365 retrieve completed. payloadType=[#[typeOf(payload) default "Unknown"]], recordCount=[#[sizeOf(payload default []) default 0]]

logger.doc:name: Log Record Count
logger.message: Successfully fetched #[sizeOf(payload default [])] records from D365 FO.

logger.doc:name: Log Records Present Branch
logger.message: Records present branch entered. recordsToProcess=[#[sizeOf(payload default []) default 0]]

logger.doc:name: Log Watermark Updated
logger.message: Watermark updated successfully for key=[${sync.watermark.key}].

logger.doc:name: Log Invoice Loop Iteration Start
logger.message: Starting invoice iteration. invoiceNumber=[#[payload.InvoiceNumber default ""]], customerAccount=[#[payload.InvoiceCustomerAccountNumber default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Invoice Loop Iteration End
logger.message: Completed invoice iteration. invoiceNumber=[#[payload.InvoiceNumber default ""]]
#["No records to sync, stopping flow."]

logger.doc:name: Log Main Logic End
logger.message: Completed main-logic-flow execution.

logger.doc:name: Log Invoice Context Set
logger.message: Invoice context set. invoiceNumber=[#[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber default ""]], invoiceDate=[#[vars.invoice.InvoiceDate default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Record Processing Start
logger.message: Starting HubSpot upsert processing for invoice=[#[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber default ""]]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output text/plain var acct = vars.invoice.InvoiceCustomerAccountNumber default "" var escaped = acct replace "'" with "''" --- "CustomersV3?\$filter=CustomerAccount eq '" ++ escaped ++ "'&\$select=OrganizationName"

logger.doc:name: Log D365 Customer Query Built
logger.message: Built D365 customer lookup query. query=[#[payload default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log D365 Customer Response
logger.message: D365 customer lookup completed. matches=[#[sizeOf(vars.d365CustomerResponse default []) default 0]], customerName=[#[((vars.d365CustomerResponse default [])[0].OrganizationName) default "Unknown Name"]]

logger.doc:name: Log HubSpot Company Search Payload Ready
logger.message: Prepared HubSpot company search payload for invoice=[#[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log HubSpot Company Search Response
logger.message: HubSpot company search completed. total=[#[vars.hubspotSearchResponse.total default 0]]

logger.doc:name: Log Company Found Branch
logger.message: Company found in HubSpot. companyId=[#[vars.hubspotSearchResponse.results[0].id default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Deal Search Payload Ready
logger.message: Prepared deal search payload. invoiceNumber=[#[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Deal Search Response
logger.message: Deal search completed. total=[#[vars.dealSearchResponse.total default 0]]

logger.doc:name: Log Deal Update Branch
logger.message: Existing deal found. Will update dealId=[#[vars.dealSearchResponse.results[0].id default ""]] for invoice=[#[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Deal Update Payload Ready
logger.message: Prepared deal update payload for invoice=[#[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Update Success
logger.message: Successfully UPDATED existing Deal for Invoice #[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber]

logger.doc:name: Log Deal Create Branch Existing Company
logger.message: No existing deal found. Will create new deal for existing companyId=[#[vars.hubspotSearchResponse.results[0].id default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Deal Create Payload Existing Company Ready
logger.message: Prepared deal create payload (existing company). invoice=[#[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Create Success
logger.message: Successfully CREATED new Deal for Invoice #[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber]

logger.doc:name: Log Missing Customer
logger.message: Could not find HubSpot Company. Creating new company with Name: #[((vars.d365CustomerResponse default [])[0].OrganizationName) default 'Unknown Name']...

logger.doc:name: Log Company Create Branch
logger.message: Company not found branch entered for invoice=[#[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Company Create Payload Ready
logger.message: Prepared company create payload. customerName=[#[((vars.d365CustomerResponse default [])[0].OrganizationName) default "Unknown Name"]]

logger.doc:name: Log Company Create Success
logger.message: Successfully created new HubSpot Company with ID #[vars.createCompanyResponse.id]

logger.doc:name: Log Deal Create Payload New Company Ready
logger.message: Prepared deal create payload (new company). companyId=[#[vars.createCompanyResponse.id default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Deal Create Success
logger.message: Successfully CREATED new Deal for Invoice #[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber default ''] linked to newly created Company.

logger.doc:name: Log Record Processing End
logger.message: Completed HubSpot upsert processing for invoice=[#[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber default ""]]

logger.doc:name: Log Record Failure
logger.message: Failed to process Invoice #[vars.invoice.InvoiceNumber default "Unknown"]. Error: #[error.description]
